facts.text: Audrey and the dogs were at a dog park on Saturday, which had a big grassy area for them to play and shaded spots for Audrey to relax.

evidence.quote: We took them to the dog park nearby last Saturday. There was a big grassy area for them to play and lots of shaded spots for me to relax.

facts.text: Audrey and the dogs enjoy being in nature, as it is different from being in the city and provides a sense of relief and freedom.

evidence.quote: Being out in nature and checking out new trails with the dogs is so different from being in the city.
Being in a nature environment is always a great way to relax.

facts.text: Andrew expressed a desire to go on a hike with Audrey and the dogs, as it has been a long time since they all spent time in nature together.

evidence.quote: I can't wait for the hike. It's been a long time since we all be in nature together.
